frequency_question: How often do executive principals with established intent to renew an expiring bilateral resource treaty successfully sign the extension within the final operational window?
membership_rule: Includes all bilateral water, transit, or resource treaties subject to expiration where the incumbent executive authorities have publicly indicated intent to renew. Excludes treaties abandoned unilaterally by choice.

cases.name: Columbia River Treaty operational framework renewals

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named cases; represents major transnational executive water treaty renewals under congruent executive will.
known_gaps: Excludes minor local sub-national basin accords.
validity_reason: Executive norms regarding resource treaty renewals remain stable across international relations over medium-term horizons.
